title: What Is an OASIS Assessment? OASIS-E Explained for Home Health
summary: What an OASIS assessment is, which OASIS-E version is current, the timepoints and deadlines, who can complete it, and how to write the SOC narrative faster.
body_markdown:

CMS, OASIS-E2 Guidance Manual (effective April 1, 2026), §1.5.1 and §1.5.5.[cms.gov/…/final-oasis-e2-manual](https://www.cms.gov/files/document/final-oasis-e2-manual-04-01-2026.pdf)↩︎


2.


OASIS-E2 Guidance Manual §1.5.2. The four conditions are any pay source, receiving skilled services, not exempt, and an SOC M0090 date on or after July 1, 2025.↩︎


3.


OASIS-E2 Guidance Manual §1.5.3. OASIS items are incorporated into the agency’s own comprehensive assessment and are not a comprehensive assessment on their own.↩︎
